announcements.title: Online Quran Classes
announcements.content:
Mahmud Sabir (Alfurqan) Masjid announces online Qur’an classes for children & beginners, covering basic recitation to confident reading, with certificates & Quran competitions.
Class details: Tues & Thurs 5–7 PM, for ages 7+. Limited spaces.
Teacher: Sheikh Mohammed Khattab, Al-Azhar graduate, 30 yrs’ experience in teaching Quran.( Teacher at Dar Al-Ulum- Al Islamiya School)
Fees: £50 per month. 
For more info/register: 07821 107072.

announcements.title: BECOME A KHADIM - SUPPORT YOUR MASJID
announcements.content:
Help keep Mahmud Sabir Masjid running. Your masjid relies on your support to cover utility bills, maintenance, facilities, and the Imam's payroll.
Set up a monthly Standing Order. Every donation, whether £5, £10, £20 or more, makes a HUGE difference.
Donate or set up a recurring donation by clicking the Hibabox link in the Information section of the Mawaqit App, or set up a Standing Order to MahmudnSabir Masjid:
Sort Code: 20-08-64
Account No: 83455882
Jazākumullāhu Khayran for your support.

announcements.title: EXPLORE THE QUR’AN WITH SHEIKH MUSTAFA
announcements.content:
Join us this Thursday 17th September and every Thursday after Salatul Maghreb as we come together to journey through Juz Tabarak. 
A chance to pause, reflect and reconnect with the words of Allah, gaining understanding and lessons we can carry into our everyday lives — with Sheikh Mustafa Razzak in his inimitable style. 
We would love for you to join us. Bring your family and friends and be part of this beautiful journey with the Qur’an.

announcements.title: Tafsir of the Holy Quran
announcements.content:
Mahmud Sabir (Al Furqan) Masjid is pleased to invite you to our weekly Tafsir of the Holy Qur’an with: 
Ustadh Umar El Jaizari 
After Maghrib Salah
Every Saturday 
All are welcome. Please join us and bring your family and friends Insha'Allah.

announcements.title: TAFSIR OF THE HOLY QUR’AN IN URDU
announcements.content:
Mahmud Sabir (Al Furqan) Masjid is pleased to invite you to our weekly Tafsir of the Holy Qur’an with Sheikh Muhammad Hafeez Ullah Khan, every Sunday.
Tonight after Maghrib Salah
All brothers and sisters are warmly invited to attend and benefit.
